description: a decision sealed: structural fields kept, the rest pseudonymized or encrypted per subject
a null field whose subject has no key is kept as null; no approver key is needed
a record with no data subject: every field kept, no statement subject
a field the schema does not declare is refused
a plain digest in a kept field not declared structural is refused
a personal field with no key for its subject is refused
a schema that keeps a personal field cannot seal
every key present: the record opens to its clear fields
the user key is destroyed: the user's fields read as erased, the approver's still open
a ciphertext the payload store no longer holds reads as missing
a blob whose bytes do not hash to the committed digest is refused
the leaf id changed: the AEAD binding refuses the ciphertext
a tampered commitment is refused
a tampered pseudonym is refused
a wrong key for a present subject is refused, never read as erased
a block that is not envelope v2 is refused
ciphertexts that do not cover every non-kept field are refused
a class outside kept, pseudonym and payload is refused
one committed field disclosed: its value and k_field, never the subject key
a field without a commitment cannot be disclosed
the disclosure verifies against the commitment
another value under the same field key does not verify
a disclosure naming another leaf does not verify
a schema that may seal: no problems
personal or digest-of-personal fields kept, and digest-named kept fields not declared structural
a non-kept field with no subject role, a pseudonym with a commitment, a kept field naming a key
every record in envelope v2: erasable, and the kept class is printed
one v1 record makes the journal not erasable
a class the schema fixes: the approver payload is padded to exactly 512 bytes
a longer approver name gives a ciphertext of the same size as S8
a plaintext larger than its fixed size is refused, never padded past it
a signed ciphertext length that is not the blob's length is refused
every ciphertext padded to a multiple of 256: no problems
read under a schema that fixes payload at 512 bytes, a 256-byte payload ciphertext is found
a ciphertext whose plaintext is not a multiple of 256 bytes is found from the signed block alone
a block of another schema is not judged against this one
a fixed size on the kept class, and one that is not a positive multiple of 256
a schema that fixes payload but leaves a pseudonym ciphertext padded: its length is still a channel
a keyed reference to an approver inside a body it signs
the same approver under another leaf gives an unrelated reference
the same approver under another label gives an unrelated reference
a sealed record's signed bytes show no canary, in clear or under a plain digest
a v1-style record: a name in clear (any case), an object in clear, an upper-case hex digest and a base64 digest of JCS bytes are each found
